question.worked_solution:
First, notice that the numbers $125$ and $8$ are both perfect cubes. 

So, to determine the value of $\sqrt[3]{\frac{125}{8}},$ we express $\frac{125}{8}$ as a perfect cube:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{\frac{125}{8}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{{5}^{3}}{{2}^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{5\cdot 5\cdot 5}{2\cdot 2\cdot 2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{5}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(\frac{5}{2})}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{5}{2} & \end{aligned}
$$
